_meta.description: Curated dataset sources for portfolio projects. Grows over time with user-verified additions.
_meta.how_to_add: After a live search finds a reliable dataset source, confirm with the user and add an entry here.

sources.name: Kaggle Datasets
sources.notes: Largest repository. Quality varies widely. Check dataset size and recency before committing.

sources.name: data.gov
sources.notes: US government open data. Reliable but can be messy. Good for policy and public sector projects.

sources.name: UCI Machine Learning Repository
sources.notes: Classic datasets for ML projects. Well-documented. Many are small but clean.

sources.name: FiveThirtyEight Data
sources.notes: Clean, well-documented datasets behind FiveThirtyEight articles. Good for storytelling projects.

sources.name: MovieLens
sources.notes: Movie ratings dataset. Multiple sizes (100K to 25M ratings). Great for recommendation and streaming projects.

sources.name: TMDB API
sources.notes: Movie and TV metadata. Good for content analysis and media industry projects.

sources.name: Spotify Web API
sources.notes: Audio features, tracks, artists. Good for music analytics and recommendation projects.

sources.name: FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data)
sources.notes: 800K+ economic time series. Gold standard for financial and economic analysis projects.

sources.name: Yahoo Finance
sources.notes: Stock prices, fundamentals, market data. Use yfinance library for easy access.

sources.name: World Bank Open Data
sources.notes: Global development indicators. Good for international comparison and macro-level analysis.

sources.name: Google BigQuery Public Datasets
sources.notes: Includes Google Analytics sample, GitHub activity, Stack Overflow, and more. Good for SQL-heavy projects.

sources.name: Instacart Market Basket Analysis
sources.notes: 3M+ orders from 200K+ users. Great for product analytics, basket analysis, and user behavior projects.

sources.name: Yelp Open Dataset
sources.notes: Reviews, businesses, check-ins, tips. Good for NLP, sentiment analysis, and business analytics.

sources.name: Bureau of Labor Statistics
sources.notes: Employment, wages, productivity, prices. Good for workforce planning and operational analytics projects.

sources.name: StatsBomb Open Data
sources.notes: Detailed soccer match event data. Great for sports analytics projects.
